title: Encouragement
definition: Encouragement is the ministry of strengthening, comforting, urging, and building up other believers in Christ.
summary: God's people need encouragement because the Christian life includes suffering, temptation, weakness, and weariness.
christFocus: Christ comforts His people and uses believers to encourage one another in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's people need encouragement because the Christian life includes suffering, temptation, weakness, and weariness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
